listing.name: Moar XIV
listing.summary: Adds more XIV faction ships to the game.
listing.aiSummary: Adds more XIV faction ships to the game.

description:
Hey hey Ladies and gents, aliens and good old organ traders. Here is the Moar XIV pack, an XIV pack that brings more XIV into the game for XIV bloat, featuring XIV.

This mod adds as you can probably tell, more XIV ships to spice up your tax collecting roleplay on a bigger scale!

Maxwell (discord username) the gigachad has repainted new and improved sprites of all the XIV ships in this mod.

The mod has officially moved from it's hue shift days into proper repaint baby!

**EDIT: If you want to make changes like modifying the sprites, adding new ships, or other things i haven't covered from this mod. Hit me up in forum DMs or my discord "Slavodan". I'm fairly open to discussion and unless you suggest something so outlandish only a satbomb will fix it, I will most likely be okay with the suggestion.

Here is the github virus download link:

https://github.com/mxwl404/Moar-XIV/releases/download/v2.1.2/Moar.XIV.v2.1.2.zip

Ship Roster:

https://imgur.com/a/nSJBoTK

Changelog

SpoilerV2.0

Changes:

+Reworked all sprites

+Added Pegasus XIV class ship

+Added version checker support

V2.1

-Fixed Endless MK1 XIV weapon groups

-Fixed Endless MK1 XIV description

-updated Owl XIV Spec Ops sprites, thanks to Flonxen on the forums

+Added Endless MK2 XIV class ship

+Added Titan XIV class ship

+Added Albyss XIV portrait and bounty (Appears at level 12)

hotfix 2.1.2

The engineers reviewed that in fact it was not antimatter, but crude oil, while corrupt hegemony officials have been siphoning off the antimatter for their own personal sales and pockets. they have been executed for high treason, XIV officers may now fly with proper fuel in their antimatter tanks.

-fixed multiple ships "built in erratic fuel ejector". Investigation of responsible officials is complete. Thanks to overdramaticpan on forums for bringing the issue to our attention.

[close]
